faq.q: What happens to transparency when I convert to JPG?
faq.a: JPG has no transparency, so transparent areas become the background colour you choose (white by default). WebP and PNG keep transparency.
JPG for photos, WebP when you want the smallest file with modern support, PNG for flat graphics, screenshots and anything with transparency.

faq.q: How many images can I convert at once?
faq.a: Up to 30 files in one batch. They are processed one by one in your browser, so nothing is uploaded and there is no queue.
